visual.description: A man looking directly into the camera with a challenging and skeptical expression.

vo.en: Stand sideways against a flat wall right now. Press your shoulder, hip, and foot tight against the surface.

visual.description: A man's side profile as he presses his body firmly against a blank interior wall.

vo.en: Now, without moving your upper body, try to lift your outside leg off the floor. Just one inch.

visual.description: Close up of a man's feet in sneakers attempting to lift one leg while the other remains glued to the wall.

vo.en: But here is the creepy part. Your brain is screaming at your muscles to move, yet nothing happens.

visual.description: Macro shot of a male eye widening in realization with fast digital overlay effects.

vo.en: It’s a center of gravity glitch. To stay balanced, your torso must lean over your standing foot to stay upright.

visual.description: A man performing a balancing act or walking carefully along a wooden beam outdoors.

vo.en: Since the wall blocks that shift, your weight stays centered, making it physically impossible to lift one leg.

visual.description: An antique metal scale tipping back and forth before coming to a sudden halt.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow’s brain test and comment FAIL if you tipped over. You can't beat physics, which is exactly why...

visual.description: Close up of male hands scrolling and interacting with a smartphone screen quickly.
